title: The RSI(2) dip buy made 114% on SPY over 25 years and 74% on IWM with the exact same code
author: person-person12
selftext:
Most ppl who find a strategy that works test it on one ticker, usually SPY, and then start running it on whatever else is on their watchlist. I wanted to see how much of the result actually carries over, so I took the RSI(2) dip buy I already had saved in [Agenticks](https://www.agenticks.ca/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=autopilot&utm_content=ai_trading) and ran the same code on IWM with nothing retuned.

Daily candles, January 2001 to March 2026, $10k start, long only, buy when the 2 day RSI gets washed out and sell on the bounce, $0.50 commission and 3 cents a share slippage charged on every fill.

**SPY:** 186 trades, 75.8% wins, profit factor 2.20, +114.2%, max drawdown 14.9%

**IWM:** 180 trades, 68.9% wins, profit factor 1.52, +74.0%, max drawdown 20.1%

The signal fires almost exactly as often on small caps, it just **wins less often and gives back more on the losers**, so the same rules that looked clean on SPY come out a lot thinner.

Costs made the gap bigger. The charge per share was the same on both, but IWM traded at a much lower share price for most of the window, so the same $10k bought far more shares and the bill came to $3,406 against $968 on SPY. Before costs IWM was at +108%, so **about a third of its gross return went to fills.**

comments.author: Vader1138
comments.body:
I can’t replicate the RSI(2) that you claim.  There is something wrong with the outcomes you are showing or the description of the setup.

If you’re not a bot, can you provide more detail

replies.author: person-person12
replies.body:
Fair ask, heres everything so you can line it up. SPY daily, Jan 2001 to Mar 2026, $10k, long only, whole account in each trade. Buy when the close is **above the 200 day SMA and the 2 period Wilder RSI is under 10**, sell on the first close above the 5 day SMA. The signal fires on the close and fills at the **next day's open**, with commission and slippage charged on both sides, about $970 across the 186 trades. Prices are split adjusted but not dividend adjusted, so no dividends are in that 114%. The first trade isnt until May 2003 because SPY spent most of 2001 and 2002 under its 200 day.

The two mismatches I see most are filling on the signal candle's close and using Cutler RSI instead of Wilder, which one are you running?
